title: On Occurring to me in the night
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：occur　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 occur 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the thought ① occurred to me in the night in silence, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the thought ② occurs to me in the night twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ occur to me in the night at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ occurred to me in the night before — a line in the logbook for July 1956 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Occurring to me in the night in silence, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the thought ever ⑥ occurs to nobody else in the boat twice over before the July rains, nobody in the harbour would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ occur to nobody else in the boat twice over and never speak of it again.

By 1969 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a second thought ⑧ occurs to nobody else in the boat in silence every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the harbour said a word; ⑨ The thought occurred to me in the night again in 1972, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To occur to me in the night, my mother said in 1974, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, the thought occurs to me in the night twice over again and the thought must occur to me in the night in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 浮现（一般过去式 occurred to me in the night：1962 年那个念头头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 浮现（一般现在 occurs to me in the night：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 浮现（不定式 to occur to me in the night：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 浮现（过去完成时 had occurred to me in the night：1956 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 浮现（动名词 occurring to me in the night 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 想起（occurs to nobody else in the boat：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真想起船里别人谁也没想到）
G. v. 想起（occur to nobody else in the boat：let it 之后的原形，指随它去船里别人谁也没想到）
H. v. 浮现（后段两处：后来的那个念头照例 occurs to nobody else in the boat，而那个念头在 1972 年又一次 occurred to me in the night）

items.q: occurred to me in the night
occurs to me in the night
to occur to me in the night
occurred to me in the night before

occurs to nobody else in the boat in silence

to occur to me in the night

answers.why: occur 意为“浮现”，1962 年那个念头一言不发地浮现半夜浮现在我的脑中，那是渔港里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 occurred。
occur 意为“浮现”，自那以后那个念头来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 occurs。
occur 意为“浮现”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯浮现半夜浮现在我的脑中”，此处为不定式 to occur to me in the night。
occur 意为“浮现”，航海日志里 七月 那行字说明早在 1969 年之前就有人浮现过，故用过去完成时 had occurred。
occur 意为“浮现”，那个念头说“浮现半夜浮现在我的脑中这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 occurring to me in the night 作主语。
occur 意为“想起”，叔叔说的是“万一那个念头真想起船里别人谁也没想到”，if 从句里用一般现在 occurs to nobody else in the boat。
occur 意为“想起”，老手们的规矩是“随它想起船里别人谁也没想到”（let it occur to nobody else in the boat），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
occur 意为“浮现”，后来的那个念头每个汛期都照例想起船里别人谁也没想到，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 occurs。
occur 意为“浮现”，那个念头在 1972 年在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地浮现半夜浮现在我的脑中，用一般过去式 occurred 叙述。
occur 意为“浮现”，结尾那句是母亲 1974 年的话：要浮现半夜浮现在我的脑中，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，那个念头一言不发地浮现半夜浮现在我的脑中；渔港里每一个船工都说这是头一回。（occurred to me in the night）
多年以后，那个念头仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（occurs to me in the night）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯浮现半夜浮现在我的脑中这件事本身。（to occur to me in the night）
早在 1956 年就有人浮现半夜浮现在我的脑中，七月那天航海日志上的一行字就是证据。（had occurred to me in the night）
那个念头说过，一言不发地浮现半夜浮现在我的脑中这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（occurring to me in the night 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：随它想起船里别人谁也没想到，以后再也不要提起。（let it occur to nobody else in the boat）
answers: In 1962 the thought occurred to me in the night in silence, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three seasons on, the thought still occurs to me in the night twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to occur to me in the night at all was the part nobody had expected.
The thought had occurred to me in the night long before 1969, and the line in the logbook for July proves it.
Occurring to me in the night in silence, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: let it occur to nobody else in the boat twice over and never speak of it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 occur 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the thought occurred to me in the night in silence, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
Even now the thought occurs to me in the night twice over whenever the harbour asks.
Occurring to me in the night in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If the thought ever occurs to nobody else in the boat twice over before the July rains, nobody knows what to do next.
A second thought occurs to nobody else in the boat in silence every season, asking nothing about the past.
The thought occurred to me in the night again in 1972, and this time nothing was written down.
